or1200_dc_fsm -- data cache controller FSM

The controller sits in the IDLE state until a request arrives. A request is
accepted only when dc_en and dcqmem_cycstb_i are both asserted.

On a load access the controller enters the CLOAD state, where it performs the
tag hit/miss evaluation. On tagcomp_miss with biudata_valid, the FSM advances
to LREFILL3 and drives burst for the remainder of the refill.

On a store access the controller enters the CSTORE state and writes through to
the bus.

Store-miss refill is present only when OR1200_DC_STORE_REFILL is defined; in
this configuration the SREFILL4 state does not exist.

The captured request address is held in saved_addr for the duration of the
access.
